technical-summary: S16: retired the bash launcher, its plan-check and sdk-check helpers, the Python serving supervisor and commands, and the Python release installer after the leased S15 hardware acceptance (dense cohort PASS; helper cohort equal greedy hash and clean stops; native flashnext-4gpu served 538 requests with no errors). bc-serve and bc-release are the only serving and install entry points; the pre-S16 launcher is preserved at the tag archive/pre-s16-launcher. Evidence: docs/evidence/2026-11-19-rsc02-s15-acceptance.
user-summary-candidate: The engine's start-up and release install path no longer uses Python or the old launcher script; the native bc-serve and bc-release do all of it.
